title: DireLeak: Cross-socket Cache Timing Channels Exploiting Memory Directory (MICRO 2026 artifact)
description:
Artifact for the MICRO 2026 paper DireLeak: Cross-socket Cache Timing Channels Exploiting Memory Directory. It reverse-engineers the geometry and allocation policy of the Intel memory directory (MD/HitME) cache and builds two attacks on top of it: a cross-domain covert channel between a domain-isolated trojan and spy, and an ML-model fingerprinting side channel. A menu-driven orchestrator provisions the host, drives the counter server, runs each experiment and renders the paper figures inline in the terminal.

Artifacts 1-6 require a dual-socket Intel Xeon host with the memory directory cache. Artifact 7 (Figures 14 and 15) ships the trained classifiers and 300 real attack traces and runs offline on any machine with numpy and matplotlib.
